column1: # Vol VI runover ledger — THE authoritative record of footer-runover tests.
# One line per chunk, in BUILD order. Every chunk in vol6/ must appear exactly
# once, including the ones that tested negative — the roster IS the denominator,
# and `tools/check-vol5-census.py` cross-checks it against the filesystem.
# Format: <slug>\t<events>   where <events> is `-` for none, else a
# ⛔ COMMAS, never semicolons — the checker swallows a semicolon line silently.
# ⛔ A `-` IS AN ASSERTION, NOT AN ABSENCE. Write it only after reading the head
# of every incoming register BEFORE its first numeral; a runover's first line is
# set flush left where a numbered entry is indented. Nothing re-derives a `-`
# except the next chunk reading the same leaf.
# ⚠ An inherited runover is logged by the chunk that OWNS the note, once. A
# runover on a leaf this chunk shares but does not own is the neighbour's line.
